Why is Conquest of Humanity the specific event you're worried about?
If locations are so important to your decks that CoH is a recurring
problem, perhaps you should build some decks that either don't use
them, or can afford to lose them later in the game. You could also try
using Insurance Scam to scrape something back if CoH hits the table,
though you're really better off just relying less on locations.

Jesse
